findings.description: comp_tickets only calls require_login, so any logged-in attendee can issue up to 50 free tickets per request to any holder. Other privileged handlers (cancel_event, attendee_list) use require_role. Anyone can drain event capacity and bypass payment.
findings.suggestion: Call require_role(request.user, Role.STAFF, Role.ADMIN) (or ADMIN) instead of require_login, then use the returned user for issued_by.
findings.title: Complimentary ticket endpoint lacks role authorization
